title: AmendmentProposal
description: Grundnorm G7: a proposed persistent change to C/L/P institutional assets. Engine validates shape; layer is derived from target_asset by the fail-closed path whitelist in sciteam/amendment.py, never trusted from this document.

target_asset.description: Path relative to the organization asset root (e.g. teams/paradigms/debate_elo.yaml). Layer P/L/C/G is derived from this path by whitelist; G or off-whitelist paths are rejected at preflight.

declared_layer.description: Proposer's belief about the layer. Informational only; mismatch with the derived layer is recorded as a review flag.

diff.description: Unified diff against the incumbent asset (or full content for add). Applied verbatim by apply_amendment; no free-form edits outside this diff.

failure_refs.description: Resolvable run-artifact paths (runs/...) evidencing the failure pattern. Audited by amendment_audit; unresolvable refs fail alignment per G7.4.

falsifier.description: Shadow-ledger condition under which the proposal must be withdrawn (G7.4 falsifiability duty).

rollback.description: How to restore the incumbent asset if the amendment is rolled back after promotion.

proposer.description: agent_key of the drafting seat. For P layer must differ from verifier and promoter keys recorded in the ledger.

review_refs.description: Paths to review/red-team/shadow-ledger artifacts accumulated as the proposal advances.

human_approval.description: For C-layer promotions: budget_gate decision reference (G7.2). Null otherwise.

metadata.description: Free-form extension slot (mission id, campaign id, series position, etc.).
